title: Power Apps: speech as an input source for form fill assistance in model-driven apps
summary: The app-level controls row incorrectly groups Smart paste with the toolbar: its setting and API change the toolbar, while Microsoft documents a separate Smart paste setting. The API itself exists, and the roadmap facts and published licensing requirements are supported.

claims.claim: Power Apps form fill assistance in model-driven apps accepts speech as an input source.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's first sentence with 'Microsoft plans to let users in model-driven apps record speech with a microphone icon and use the transcript as a source for form fields.' The roadmap status is still In development.
